sections.title: Orchestra rehearsal route
sections.transcript:
VISITOR: I'm trying to get to the orchestra rehearsal. My map shows two possible routes. Which one would you recommend?

ASSISTANT: Start at the stage door. From there, walk towards the costume rack. Stay on the same side until you can see the sign for the rehearsal room.

VISITOR: Can I go through the middle? It looks a lot shorter on the map.

ASSISTANT: I'd avoid the loading bay today. A delivery truck is about to arrive. If you're meeting a group, wait by the sign so they can spot you.
